parameters.name: InstanceId
parameters.description: The instance ID of the Cloud Call Center.

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description: The page size. Default value: 10. Maximum value: 100.

parameters.name: SkillGroups
parameters.description: The list of skill group IDs, separated by commas. A maximum of 50 skill groups can be specified. If this parameter is not specified, all skill groups are queried.
